newsitem.title: FRANCE: ATHLETICS-DEVERS WINS WORLD INDOOR 60 METRES TITLE.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-DEVERS WINS WORLD INDOOR 60 METRES TITLE.

text.p: Olympic women's 100 metres champion Gail Devers won the women's 60 metres title on the opening day of the world indoor championships on Friday.
American Devers, the 1993 champion, clocked 7.06 seconds.
Chandra Sturrup of the Bahamas was second in 7.15, with Frenchwoman Frederique Bangue third in 7.17.
World record holder Irina Privalova of Russia pulled up before the finish clutching her left leg and did not finish the race.
